svg.aria-label: Hi, I am Mihai. I study Economic Informatics at the Bucharest University of Economic Studies. I got curious about what happens after you press Enter, and I never really stopped. That took me into networks and servers, the backend that runs on them, the cloud, and a habit of automating things. Now I am putting AI agents to work in that world, and I like seeing how all of it helps a business. The photo shows me looking over a city through a wire fence, with small lights travelling along the wires.
